outline: This lecture is designed to cover the Carbon caused climate migration, renewable energy, the technology and applications of organic Rankine cycle. This course starts from the angle of the planet protection to (1) investigate the use of clean energy, (2) to understand their advantages and restrictions, and (3) to study the conversion technology and development of ORC and advanced clean energy systems.
assessment: written report, oral presentation & PPT, presence in the class.
